description: This file defines an interface 'PersistenceStreamConfig' that specifies configuration settings related to persistence stream behavior, including a method to retrieve the maximum bulk size for write operations. It also contains an enumeration 'PersistenceStreamConfigValue' that provides default configuration values and paths for these settings.

classes.name: PersistenceStreamConfig
classes.description: An interface defining configuration methods for persistence stream settings.

classes.name: PersistenceStreamConfig.PersistenceStreamConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining known configuration path expressions and their default values for persistence stream configuration.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of write operations to perform in a single bulk.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the configuration setting.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path expression for the setting.
